guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The digest shows checkoutservice memory usage spiked by 1876% (z=375.25) and CPU by 4411% (z=219.84), directly correlating with its 764% latency increase. All other services in the trace path show negligible metric changes, isolating the fault to checkoutservice resource exhaustion.

proposed_fix.description: Perform a rolling restart of checkoutservice to clear the memory leak and restore baseline resource usage, or increase its memory limits if the spike reflects legitimate load.
